name: Core Keeper
description: Cozy mining-sandbox survival for up to 8 players. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous); players join via a Game ID over Steam relay — no port forwarding needed.

variables.label: Direct-connect port
variables.description: Only relevant if you bypass Steam relay networking with extra launch options; by default no open ports are needed.

notes: The server prints a Game ID to the console once ready (also written to GameID.txt) — players join with that ID from the in-game menu; traffic goes over the Steam relay so no ports need to be opened. World and settings flags (-world, -worldname, -maxplayers) can be appended to the start command. The bundled _launch.sh sets up the required Steam client libraries.
